title: The Prismatic Creature Battler
engine: Godot 4.7.2 validation/export fixture + custom HTML5 Canvas2D/WebGL playable runtime

risk_register.description: FLUX.2 Klein 4B fp8 peaks near 11.1 GB on 12 GB RTX 5070 Ti Laptop GPU.
risk_register.mitigation: Run all ComfyUI generations strictly sequentially and record cold/warm timings.

risk_register.description: Intense rainbow holographic foil can obscure card names, stats, or combat readability.
risk_register.mitigation: Mask foil diffraction strictly to creature highlights, scale patterns, and frame borders while keeping text plates dark high-contrast obsidian.

risk_register.description: Auto-battler trigger chains can feel random if not visually and textually telegraphed.
risk_register.mitigation: Render explicit Resonance arcs (Voltbrand -> Refractive Ward -> Phase Rend) with step-by-step causal Combat Log entries and slow-mo/step inspection.

non_goals: Hundreds of filler cards or gacha pack monetization
Pay-to-win stat boosts on rare foils
Opaque black-box RNG combat without causal combat log telemetry
